relevance_rank_note: Isogenic human iPSC astrocytes; measures endocytic uptake and endosome markers (surrogates for receptor recycling), including a null for the Rab11 recycling endosome.

description: Isogenic APOE4 iPSC-derived astrocytes internalized less fluorescent transferrin in a 5-min pulse than APOE3 astrocytes, without lower transferrin-receptor expression, indicating reduced clathrin-mediated uptake of a recycling receptor's ligand.
quote: Using fluorescently-tagged Tf, we again observed that APOE4 astrocytes internalized less Tf than APOE3 astrocytes.
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (less transferrin internalization per cell in astrocytes)
system: Human iPSC-derived astrocytes, isogenic APOE3 (parental) vs CRISPR-edited APOE4; Alexa647-transferrin 25 ug/mL, 5 min at 37C, confocal quantification of Tf intensity per cell. Deviation: in-vitro iPSC-derived (fetal-like) astrocytes; measures ligand internalization, not receptor recycling itself; ARF6 not examined. Note: PMC author manuscript read, cited as published Cell Rep version. Donor note (Fig S1A): APOE3 parental line Coriell AG09173 from a 75-year-old unaffected female; APOE4 parental line AG10788 from an 87-year-old female with confirmed AD diagnosis, so one isogenic pair is on an aged AD-donor background.
human_check: Effect ~49% reduction read off bar heights (APOE3 ~1.8e6 vs APOE4 ~0.92e6); P=0.036 is printed on the panel itself, not in the legend text.

description: Second isogenic pair (APOE4 parental line): APOE4 astrocytes internalized less transferrin than isogenic APOE3 astrocytes in a 5-min pulse, a non-significant trend (p=0.053) that the authors describe as confirming the first pair.
quote: These results were confirmed in astrocytes derived from an independent iPSC line (Figure S1A) (Lin et al., 2018), where we again observed that APOE4 astrocytes exhibit a similar genotype-dependent decrease in early clathrin-mediated endocytosis (Figure S2I)
system: Human iPSC-derived astrocytes, second isogenic pair: APOE4 (parental, AG10788) vs CRISPR-edited APOE3; fluorescent transferrin 5 min pulse, microscopy, transferrin intensity per cell, 30-50 cells per sample. Deviation: in-vitro iPSC astrocytes; measures ligand internalization, not receptor recycling itself; ARF6 not examined. Donor note (Fig S1A): APOE3 parental line Coriell AG09173 from a 75-year-old unaffected female; APOE4 parental line AG10788 from an 87-year-old female with confirmed AD diagnosis, so one isogenic pair is on an aged AD-donor background.
human_check: Effect read off S2I bars (APOE3 about 1.8e6 vs APOE4 about 1.3e6 per cell). P=0.053 printed on the panel; n=12-16 samples from the S2 legend. Marked against because not significant, though the authors present it as a confirmation.

description: AGAINST: Rab11-positive recycling endosome levels did not differ between isogenic APOE3 and APOE4 iPSC-derived astrocytes, in contrast to the early-endosome decrease.
quote: we noted no difference in Rab11 (recycling endosome) levels between cells of the APOE3 and APOE4 genotype (Figure S2A,B)
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (no change in Rab11+ recycling endosomes in astrocytes) [AGAINST]
system: Human iPSC-derived astrocytes, isogenic APOE3 vs APOE4; Rab11 immunofluorescence intensity per cell, APOE3 (parental) vs APOE4 (isogenic), 30-50 cells per sample. Deviation: in-vitro iPSC astrocytes; recycling-endosome marker abundance is a surrogate for receptor recycling flux. Donor note (Fig S1A): APOE3 parental line Coriell AG09173 from a 75-year-old unaffected female; APOE4 parental line AG10788 from an 87-year-old female with confirmed AD diagnosis, so one isogenic pair is on an aged AD-donor background.
human_check: S2A bars: APOE3 (parental) about 1.00 vs APOE4 (isogenic) about 0.97 Rab11 intensity per cell; no P value printed. n=7 samples of 30-50 cells (S2 legend). Supplement read in Chrome via PMC 2026-11-19.

description: APOE4 iPSC astrocytes had fewer EEA1-positive early-endosome puncta per cell than isogenic APOE3 astrocytes.
quote: We observed that the number of both Rab5 positive and EEA1 positive puncta were decreased in APOE4 compared to APOE3 astrocytes (Figure 1D–F).
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (fewer EEA1+ early endosomes in astrocytes)
system: Human iPSC-derived astrocytes, isogenic APOE3 (parental) vs APOE4; EEA1 immunofluorescence, 80-100 cells per sample. human_check: Effect ~58% reduction read off bars (~30 vs ~12.5 puncta/cell); P printed on panel.
